answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, slashed on a failed audit, no identity may audit its own recruit. By the kernel of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Every claim climbs the jade of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the pigment re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
